# Proposed Claude adapter (measurement fixture, not installed)

Load `skill/shared/router.md` and the JIT rule for the requested verb. A current `id@digest` receipt means the exact agent instruction is present only in this live context; after compaction or clear, discard it and reload. Keep the source receipt separate.

For delivery, only exit 20 with exactly one `AITM_PROVIDER_ACTION_REQUIRED:` JSON line authorizes one matching provider action. [delivery.envelope] Validate all fields, repository, PR, expected head, adapter capability, and merge method. Never use a shell merge, `gh pr merge`, or a wrapper fallback. [delivery.no-shell] After success, refusal, timeout, or ambiguity, rerun `npx aitm deliver <N>` and require its live-verified receipt before close; never retry the external mutation first. [delivery.reconcile]
